description: Urban-renewal infill (1976-1992: 109-161, 173-225, 160-178, 244-246, 265-313, 89-105): dark brown brick, flat wall top with dark roof boxes, plain two-light windows in white frames, no cornice moulding, a tall ground of dark granite piers (recessed shops under a first-floor gallery on 109-161); bitumen roof

roof-boxes.note: 109-161: two dark square roof boxes per module standing on the wall top

rhythm.bays: 2 window axes per ~6 m module; storey 3 one wide window
rhythm.identicalBays: storeys 2 and 4: two windows; storey 3: one wide window
schemaLimits: the recessed two-storey arcade with a first-floor gallery is drawn as a shop storey plus a storey of French windows behind rails
the wide three-light window on storey 3 is drawn about 1.5 m wide (photo ~2.2 m)
recessed glazed stair slots between modules
the curved drum corner and cream set-back top storey of 125 and 173-225 are not in the kit
